text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I'm back from my holiday
and
feeling fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: !? Where on earth is that voice coming from...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Was that a perfect landing or
what? I
seriously nailed it, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I went skydiving during my break and
had a blast,
so now I'm well and truly
refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's really nothing like feeling the
wind on
your face as you dance through
the air! Jumping
around like this is also
great fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears Seeking the Pearl was able to
make the
most of her day off and feels
well rested.
